name: Nyuunyuu
source:
One day, Shoji Oba asks the woman posing as his sister who she really is. Her name is Erika Chichiski. She is a boob alien from the planet Boob. A meteorite hit her planet and broke it into pieces. She escaped and roamed about space before she came to earth. Shoji doesn't really believe her story, but he gives in to the temptation of having a big breasted chic around and decides to let her stay. However, Shoji soon regrets his decision

Erika is really a mad scientist, who starts creating strange creatures using advanced technology from the planet Boob. People around Shoji begin to panic. What will be waiting for us? This game contains both a love story and a slapstick comedy. Shoji's girlfriend, Marimo Kawai, has a warm personality and really makes him happy. However, Erika's big boobs embarrass her. Inaho Watanabe, who grew up with Shoji, is beautiful, smart, and also very rich. Wakaba, Shoji's sister, is reliable and does most of the housework. Players will be able to enjoy sex with girls with big boobs. If you're a big boob lover, this game is for you!

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030222133735/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/na/nyunyu/]gamelexgs[/url]]
translation:
有一天，大场正司问那位冒充他妹妹的女人到底是谁。她的名字叫埃里卡·奇奇斯基。她是来自布布星球的布布外星人。一颗陨石击中了她的星球，将其击碎。在来到地球之前，她逃离并在太空中漫游。庄司并不真正相信她的故事，但他屈服于周围有一个大胸时尚的诱惑，决定让她留下来。然而，庄司很快就后悔了自己的决定

埃里卡（Erika）确实是一位疯狂的科学家，她开始利用布布星球的先进技术创造奇怪的生物。庄司周围的人开始恐慌。等待我们的将会是什么？该游戏既包含爱情故事，又包含闹剧喜剧。正司的女朋友河合麻里茂性格热情，确实让他很开心。然而，埃里卡的大胸部让她感到尴尬。和正司一起长大的渡边稻穗美丽、聪明，而且非常富有。庄司的妹妹若叶很可靠，承担了大部分家务。玩家将能够享受与大胸部女孩的性爱。如果你是大胸爱好者，那么这款游戏就适合你！

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20030222133735/http://gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/2001/na/nyunyu/]游戏乐克斯[/url]]
